guard.name: Town Guard
guard.description: Guards keep the peace in civilized lands. They are often found patrolling city walls, gates, and important buildings.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Small, cunning humanoids that live in dark places underground and venture out at night to raid for food and treasure.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

merchant.name: Traveling Merchant
merchant.description: A well-dressed trader who travels between towns selling goods and gathering information. Always looking for a profitable deal.
